items.title: Jane Monheit interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, August 20, 2010
items.q: One of my favorite singers on the planet is Maura O’Connell... And she was a big influence on me as a singer.

ctx.x: I have not just listened to jazz in my life. So much other music. You know in the car we’re more likely to be listening to like Zeppelin, or Jimi Hendrix, or The Beatles or Stevie Wonder or something like that. I grew up on Joni Mitchell and my father is a banjo player. I heard a lot of bluegrass growing up. And you know, for a hot second I considered singing that kind of music. One of my favorite singers on the planet is Maura O’Connell who is a brilliant singer from that genre, a beautiful folk/bluegrass…
